invariants.rule: simulation evidence cannot establish field, lab, hardware, or public-chain validation
forwarding status does not prove application effect
numerical convergence and quality acceptance are independent from ground-truth accuracy
ground truth is only a scenario/scoring input and is absent from estimator inputs
PHY_RECEIVED does not imply application delivery
simulated timestamp resolution is not hardware timing accuracy
mock and local EVM receipts cannot establish REAL_ON_CHAIN or public-network validation
missing physical or position values remain null/unavailable, never silent zero substitutes
one canonical commitment is used across publication targets and one target failure cannot corrupt another
events and publication intent survive offline operation and process restart
